name: mcp-google-health

tools.name: list_data_types
tools.description: List every Google Health data type with its kind, scope family, supported operations, and whether it needs v4beta.

tools.name: describe_schema
tools.description: Show the JSON schema of a data type payload (such as weight or sleep) or an API schema (such as Profile, Settings, PairedDevice, DataPoint).

name.description: Data type slug or schema name.

tools.name: get_identity
tools.description: Get the user's Google Health identity and numeric health user ID.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get the user's health profile: age, stride lengths, membership start.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Get the user's settings, such as units and time zone.

tools.name: get_irn_profile
tools.description: Get the user's irregular rhythm notification (IRN) enrollment profile.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update profile fields. Name each changed field in updateMask.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Update settings fields. Name each changed field in updateMask.

tools.name: list_paired_devices
tools.description: List the user's paired devices with battery level, battery status, firmware version, features, and last sync time.

deviceId.description: A resource ID without slashes. Not . or ..

tools.name: list_data_points
tools.description: List raw data points of one data type, newest first. Filter with AIP-160 on the type's time field, for example steps.interval.civil_start_time >= "2026-11-01", weight.sample_time.physical_time >= "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", daily_resting_heart_rate.date >= "2026-11-01", or sleep.interval.civil_end_time >= "2026-11-01". Use snake case in filters.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter on the data type's time field, in snake case.

dataSourceFamily.description: Data sources: all-sources (default), google-wearables (Fitbit and Pixel devices only), google-sources (Google devices, manual logs, Health Connect), or self-sources (data this client wrote).

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: get_data_point
tools.description: Get one identifiable data point, such as an exercise, sleep session, weight, or log entry.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

dataPointId.description: A resource ID without slashes. Not . or ..

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: reconcile_data_points
tools.description: List data points merged across sources into one de-duplicated stream, as the Google Health app shows them. Takes the same filters as list_data_points. Use this for sleep across sources.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter on the data type's time field, in snake case.

dataSourceFamily.description: Data sources: all-sources (default), google-wearables (Fitbit and Pixel devices only), google-sources (Google devices, manual logs, Health Connect), or self-sources (data this client wrote).

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: roll_up_data_points
tools.description: Aggregate a data type into fixed physical-time windows, such as hourly steps or 5-minute heart rate. Range is closed-open; at most 14 days for heart-rate, active-minutes, total-calories, and calories-in-heart-rate-zone, 90 days otherwise.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

windowSize.description: Window length in seconds with an s suffix, such as 3600s.

dataSourceFamily.description: Data sources: all-sources (default), google-wearables (Fitbit and Pixel devices only), google-sources (Google devices, manual logs, Health Connect), or self-sources (data this client wrote).

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: daily_roll_up_data_points
tools.description: Aggregate a data type into civil-day windows in the user's time zone, such as daily steps or calories. endDate is exclusive. At most 14 days for heart-rate, active-minutes, total-calories, and calories-in-heart-rate-zone, 90 days otherwise.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

startDate.description: Civil date in the user's time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Civil date in the user's time zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

dataSourceFamily.description: Data sources: all-sources (default), google-wearables (Fitbit and Pixel devices only), google-sources (Google devices, manual logs, Health Connect), or self-sources (data this client wrote).

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: export_exercise_tcx
tools.description: Export one exercise as TCX with GPS track, heart rate, and laps. Needs the location scope. Give outputPath to save the file instead of returning the TCX text.

partialData.description: Include data points when the exercise has no GPS data.

outputPath.description: File path for the TCX file.

tools.name: create_data_point
tools.description: Write a new data point, such as a weight, body fat, height, sleep, exercise, hydration or nutrition log, mood, symptom, menstrual period, or ovulation test. Needs the matching write scope.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

dataPoint.description: DataPoint body. Put the payload under the camelCase data type field, such as {"weight": {...}}. Call describe_schema with the data type for its fields.

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: update_data_point
tools.description: Replace a data point that this client wrote.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

dataPointId.description: A resource ID without slashes. Not . or ..

dataPoint.description: DataPoint body. Put the payload under the camelCase data type field, such as {"weight": {...}}. Call describe_schema with the data type for its fields.

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

tools.name: delete_data_points
tools.description: Delete up to 10000 data points of one data type that this client wrote.

dataType.description: Data type in kebab case, such as steps, sleep, or heart-rate. See list_data_types.

items.description: A resource ID without slashes. Not . or ..

apiVersion.description: API version. Defaults to v4, or v4beta for beta-only data types.

instructions: Reads and writes Google Health (Fitbit, Pixel Watch) data through the Google Health API v4. Start with list_data_types, then list_data_points, reconcile_data_points, or the roll-up tools. Use describe_schema before a write.
